+"""Standalone list renderer — extracted from docx_converter for reuse."""
+
+from ._list_helpers import indent_for_depth
+
+
+class ListRenderer:
+    def __init__(self, max_depth=99, fallback_marker='*'):
+        self.max_depth = max_depth
+        self.fallback_marker = fallback_marker
+
+    def render(self, paragraph, depth):
+        try:
+            indent = indent_for_depth(depth)
+        except ValueError:
+            indent = self.fallback_marker + ' '
+        return f"{indent}{paragraph.text}"
+
+    def render_with_recovery(self, paragraph, depth):
+        """Best-effort: catch arbitrary depth failures and fall back."""
+        try:
+            return self.render(paragraph, depth)
+        except Exception:
